inputs.name: HubAuthController.constructor.options
inputs.description: The required dependencies and additional route handlers used to create the controller. The client ID is returned in auth status, the service and repository fields back the built-in auth routes, and routes are added after the built-in entries so matching keys replace them.

inputs.name: HubAuthController.handle.request
inputs.description: The incoming Fetch API Request whose method and URL path select an auth route. Paths outside /api/auth/* and /api/github/* yield null; paths in either namespace are handled as a route or coded error response.

outputs.name: HubAuthController.handle
outputs.description: The resolved result of handling a request: null for paths outside the auth and GitHub namespaces, otherwise an HTTP Response. Route failures are converted to coded JSON error responses before returning.
